claims.text: Topical lidocaine or capsaicin creams: neuropathic pain in early CRPS w mild to moderate Sx; limited evidence; local burning and irritation
claims.quote: Topical lidocaine or capsaicin creams may be used for treating neuropathic pain in early CRPS with mild to moderate symptoms, though evidence of their efficacy is limited, and local side effects like burning and irritation may restrict their use.
claims.locator: Treatment of Complex Regional Pain Syndrome

claims.text: Opioids, calcitonin, oral glucocorticoids: weak evidence
claims.quote: Evidence for the efficacy of opioids, calcitonin, and oral glucocorticoids is generally weak.
claims.locator: Treatment of Complex Regional Pain Syndrome

claims.text: Sympathetic nerve blocks (anesthetic near the sympathetic ganglia): pts unresponsive to standard tx; evidence conflicting
claims.quote: Sympathetic nerve blocks, used for patients unresponsive to standard treatments, involve anesthetic infiltration near the sympathetic ganglia though evidence of their efficacy is conflicting.
claims.locator: Treatment of Complex Regional Pain Syndrome

claims.text: Neuraxial ziconotide and/or clonidine may help; intrathecal baclofen may reduce dystonia
claims.quote: Neuraxial infusion ziconotide, and/or clonidine may help, and intrathecal baclofen may reduce dystonia.
claims.locator: Treatment of Complex Regional Pain Syndrome
